evaluation_components.notes: Three announced exercises will be conducted through Google Forms. The exercises will carry 10 marks in total, distributed as 2 marks (Exercise 1), 4 marks (Exercise 2), and 4 marks (Exercise 3).

makeup_policy: For a foreseen absence in mid-semester test, comprehensive examination or quiz, the make-up request should be made personally to the Instructor-in-Charge, well ahead of the component. Reasons for unanticipated absence that qualify a student to apply for make-up include medical emergencies or personal exigencies only. In such an event, the student should contact the Instructor-in-Charge at the earliest.
